output.reason: The evidence excerpts [ev-782bc47d120d] and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] contain only "apiVersion: v1", so all we have is the computed diff. That diff says existing ImageRepository objects "stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten" and must be migrated "before a later release removes v1beta2". Nothing fails, is rejected or stops being honoured in this release, so migration-required claims mandatory work the evidence does not support. Objects work today and only a future removal of v1beta2 would break them, which makes this deprecation (review), not action.

correction.statement: The storage version of imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io changes from v1beta2 to v1. Existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 and keep working. They need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before a later release removes v1beta2.

consequence.statement: If the operator does nothing, existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 and keep working in this release. They are only at risk once a later release removes v1beta2 while v1beta2 is still listed in status.storedVersions.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading to a release that removes v1beta2, rewrite all ImageRepository objects so they are stored as v1. Then update status.storedVersions on the imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD to drop v1beta2.
